p.s: Is earning money and experience important for us?
For university students, I think every of them should have to find a part-time job.
It is not only for the money but also for the future.
First of all, for every university student, they have to play $42100 for every year.
It is such a big deal for a lower-income family.
Having a part-time job can help to alleviate the family's burden.
For me, I come from a family which is poor.
It is hard for my family to pay the money involved.
Although the salary of part-time job is not enough high, there is no doubt that it can help for the total amount.
Secondly, a university graduate cannot fit all the requirements that the employers need.
We can learn experiences during the part-time job such as communication skills through us and the clients or other useful skills.
This is a prerequisite for getting a good-pay job and it just makes the life happier.
To conclude, having a part-time job has a lots of benefits, it is highly recommended to do it.
